notes:
A big release: guided setup, a proper diff viewer, reviewable folder updates, and a long list of chat and session fixes.

### New

- **Guided setup** — a built-in assistant walks you through getting Palette ready, and the quickstart now just asks you to pick an agent.
- **Side-by-side file diffs** — changed files render as a clean, GitHub-style unified view.
- **Review folder updates before they land** — see exactly what an update will change to your folder and approve it before it's applied.
- **One-click agent setup** — turning on an agent installs everything it needs, with no terminal required.
- **Agents can read the Palette docs** — the documentation is bundled in, so agents can answer questions about Palette itself.
- **Shared HTML files in Organisational context** — shared pages now show up alongside your other org context.

### Improved

- **Read-only Drive folders are caught early** — Palette tells you a folder is read-only before you spend a session on it, and refuses to publish into one.
- **Runtimes stay up to date** — Palette checks for agent updates on launch and when you come back to the app.
- **Clearer account checks** — agents show a "checking" state while Palette verifies your account instead of looking idle.
- **Safer agent detection** — agent tools already installed on your Mac are only used when they're a recent enough version.
- **Tidier installer** — the drag-to-Applications window now has a proper background.
- **Neater composer toolbar** — the controls under the message box line up at a consistent height.

### Fixed

- **Allow All and Plan on Gemini and Mistral** — both now work on those tabs, and Allow All stays inside your workspace instead of reaching beyond it.
- **No more crossed sessions** — replies always land in the tab that asked for them, including on Gemini and Mistral.
- **Session picker no longer hangs** — if one provider fails to list its sessions, the picker still loads.
- **Permission prompts match the right tool** — approvals are resolved against the actual request.
- **Handoffs start reliably** — a handed-off session is set up once its message box is ready.
- **Publishing uses the version you reviewed** — saves send the exact revision you approved.
- **Codex model list** — the available models are checked against the Codex version Palette is actually running.
- **Slack community link** — points at a working invite again.
